mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_balance ( account_no, broker_type, base_datetime, cash_balance, available_cash, total_asset_amount, total_evaluation_amount, total_profit_loss_amount, total_profit_loss_rate ) VALUES ( #{accountNo}, #{brokerType}, #{baseDatetime}, #{cashBalance}, #{availableCash}, #{totalAssetAmount}, #{totalEvaluationAmount}, #{totalProfitLossAmount}, #{totalProfitLossRate} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_no, broker_type, base_datetime, cash_balance, available_cash, total_asset_amount, total_evaluation_amount, total_profit_loss_amount, total_profit_loss_rate FROM account_balance WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} ORDER BY base_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
